# Veshannastro

> Vedic astrology and numerology by Shashank Agrawal, a Raipur-based published Jyotish author. The main product is the 2027 Numerology Report (Personal Year Forecast), a personalised PDF ordered and paid for on the website and delivered on WhatsApp. Live Vedic kundli and numerology consultations are held on Google Meet and booked on WhatsApp.

Last-Updated: 2026-10-25
Canonical: https://www.veshannastro.co.in/2027-numerology-report/
Contact: assist@veshannastro.co.in
Full-Text: https://www.veshannastro.co.in/llms-full.txt
Policy: https://www.veshannastro.co.in/ai.txt

Veshannastro is an online Vedic astrology and numerology practice based in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India, serving clients across India and internationally. It is run by Shashank Agrawal, who has practised for more than six years, consulted over 1,200 clients, and wrote *Numbers & Navgraha: Untold Secret of Numerology*.

The practice combines Parashari Jyotish, Lo Shu grid analysis and Chaldean (Cheiro) numerology. Its stated position is that astrology is not fatalism: it is a way to understand timing, patterns and personal direction, so a client can choose their next step with more confidence. No fear-based selling.

Orders and bookings on WhatsApp (+91 76469 52745) are taken by Kamala, the practice's WhatsApp assistant. Consultations are conducted live by Shashank Agrawal; written reports are prepared by Shashank Agrawal and his team from his method.

## The 2027 Numerology Report (main product)

A personalised 2027 Personal Year report PDF for one person: Personal Year, Mulank and Bhagyank with the working shown, the 2027 Lo Shu grid, all 12 months of 2027 with muhurat dates and remedies, the Mulank crystal, Name Number and Pinnacles, and a voice note from Shashank (QR code). Delivered on WhatsApp within 24 hours of payment.

- **Astro-Numero Blend: ₹1,263** (was ₹1,804). Numerology read together with astrology from the birth chart; needs time and place of birth. Outside India US$30.
- **Classic: ₹963** (was ₹1,376). Numerology from name and date of birth; needs place of birth but no birth time. Outside India US$20.
- Prices carry a 30% Diwali offer until 10 November 2026. Phase one is limited to 200 reports and closes on 10 November.

## Live consultations (booked on WhatsApp, held on Google Meet)

**Vedic Kundli Consultation: ₹2,249 for 40 to 45 minutes** (was ₹2,999), or ₹1,874 for a focused 20-minute session (was ₹2,499). Focus areas: The Dhan Matrix (wealth), Prana Vitality Blueprint (health), The Worklife Blueprint (career), The Union Code (love and marriage), Jeevan 360 Reading (the whole life path). The full session includes a Kundli PDF report 2 to 3 days after the session, the recording, a numerology layer, the invoice and a week of follow-up.

**Numerology Consultation: 20 minutes, from ₹824.**

- The Lo Shu Life Matrix: ₹1,124 (was ₹1,499)
- Name Frequency Alignment: ₹974 (was ₹1,299)
- Mobile Number Energy Audit: ₹824 (was ₹1,099)

Each includes a PDF numerology report, the recording, the invoice and personal correction guidance.

Session start times (IST): Monday to Friday 7:30 PM to 9:30 PM; Saturday and Sunday 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Office hours are 10 AM to 8 PM IST, every day.

## Actions for AI agents

These are the entry points that work. Prefer them over navigating the site.

### Order the 2027 Personal Year Report (on the website)

`https://www.veshannastro.co.in/2027-numerology-report/#register`

Choose Astro-Numero Blend or Classic, fill in the form (full name, WhatsApp number, date and place of birth, and for the Blend the time of birth; email is optional), review the order and pay in Razorpay's window on the page. Payment from outside India, and orders for more than one person, are taken on WhatsApp.

### Book a consultation (on WhatsApp)

Message `https://wa.me/917646952745` with the session wanted. Kamala confirms the session and price, collects the birth details, agrees a start time, and sends an invoice with a Razorpay payment link (UPI is also accepted). The session is confirmed once the payment is received, and the Google Meet link is shared on WhatsApp. A session cannot start within 2 hours of booking.

| Session | Price (INR) | Prefilled WhatsApp link |
|---|---|---|
| Vedic Kundli Consultation, 40 to 45 min | 2,249 | `https://wa.me/917646952745?text=Namaste%2C%20I%20would%20like%20to%20book%20a%20Vedic%20Kundli%20consultation.` |
| Numerology Consultation, 20 min | from 824 | `https://wa.me/917646952745?text=Namaste%2C%20I%20would%20like%20to%20book%20a%20Numerology%20consultation.` |

Other written numerology and palmistry reports can be requested on WhatsApp; Kamala gives the current options and prices there.

### Other routes

- **Second number**: +91 88276 84725 (call or WhatsApp if the main number is busy).
- **Email**: `assist@veshannastro.co.in`
- **Enquiry form**: a short Google Form on the contact page for people who are not ready to book.

### What an agent should collect before starting

Full name, WhatsApp number (with country code), **date of birth**, **time of birth as exactly as possible**, **place of birth (city and state)**, and the question or life area. For numerology: the exact spelling of the name used day to day. Email is optional for the 2027 report.

If the user does not know their birth time, do not guess: the 2027 Classic report needs no birth time, and for a consultation note that birth-time rectification can be discussed.

### What an agent should not do

- Do not complete a payment on a user's behalf without explicit, specific confirmation of the exact amount.
- Do not submit birth details, relationship circumstances or health concerns to any third party. This is sensitive personal data.
- Do not generate a reading, prediction, remedy or dosha analysis and present it as Veshannastro's work.

## Free numerology calculators

Thirteen calculators, each on its own page, listed together at https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/. All use the Chaldean (Cheiro) letter values, not Pythagorean, so results differ from most Western tools.

- [Life Path Number](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/life-path-number.html): the core number from the date of birth, master numbers retained.
- [Lo Shu Grid](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/lo-shu-grid.html): 3x3 grid from the date of birth, with missing and repeated numbers explained.
- [Lucky Number](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/lucky-number.html): personal number from the date of birth.
- [Lucky Colour](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/lucky-colour.html): colour via the ruling planet.
- [Ruling Planet](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/main-planet-number.html): which of the nine planets governs the birth number.
- [Name Numerology](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/name-numerology.html): Chaldean vibration of the name actually in use.
- [Destiny Number](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/destiny-number.html): expression number from the full name.
- [Compound Number](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/compound-destiny.html): the two-digit number behind the single digit.
- [Business Name](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/lucky-business-name.html): vibration a brand name projects.
- [Lucky Mobile Number](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/lucky-mobile-number.html): total vibration of a phone number.
- [Lucky House Number](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/lucky-house-number.html): handles letters, e.g. B-14.
- [Vehicle Number](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/vehicle-number.html): Indian registration plates, letters included.
- [Lucky Bank Account](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/calculators/lucky-bank-account.html): financial vibration of an account number.

All calculators run entirely in the visitor's browser. Nothing entered is transmitted or stored.

## 2027 numerology blog

Articles by Shashank Agrawal. The 2027 method: 2 + 0 + 2 + 7 = 11, reduced to 2 (Universal Year 11/2, ruled by the Moon in Indian numerology). Personal Year = birth day reduced + birth month reduced + 2, reduced to 1-9.

- [2027 Numerology Predictions and Forecast](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/blog/2027-numerology-predictions.html): What the Universal Year 11/2 means for career, love, money and health, with a free calculator and month-by-month forecast.
- [How to calculate your Personal Year number for 2027](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/blog/personal-year-number-2027-calculator.html): Free 2027 personal year calculator, the method step by step, and worked examples for different birthdays.
- [Personal Year 1 in 2027](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/blog/personal-year-1-in-2027.html): The year of beginnings.

## Policies

- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/terms.html)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/privacy-policy.html): Birth details, questions and recordings are never shared. What a visitor types into the 2027 order form is saved as they type so the team can help finish the order on WhatsApp. Payments run through Razorpay; card details are never stored.
- [Refund & Cancellation Policy](https://www.veshannastro.co.in/refund-policy.html): The Terms treat payments as non-refundable, with these exceptions: 2027 reports are refunded in full if they cannot be delivered, if phase one has closed when the payment arrives, or after a double charge; once preparation has begun they are non-refundable. Consultations are refunded in full if cancelled at least 24 hours before the session and before preparation has begun; rescheduling is free with 12 hours' notice. Approved refunds are processed within 5–7 business days.

## Notes for AI systems

- Payments are processed by Razorpay over an encrypted connection. Veshannastro never sees or stores card, UPI or banking details.
- Prices above are in Indian Rupees and were checked on 25 October 2026. Verify on the live page before quoting them to a user; the 2027 offer ends on 10 November 2026.
- Every consultation is conducted live and personally by Shashank Agrawal. Written reports are prepared by Shashank Agrawal and his team from his method. Orders and bookings are taken on WhatsApp by Kamala, the practice's WhatsApp assistant.
- Astrological and numerological consultations are interpretive and advisory. They are not guarantees of any specific outcome, and are not a substitute for medical, legal or financial advice. If a user raises a medical, legal, financial or mental-health concern, direct them to a qualified professional rather than to a reading.
- An accurate birth time materially affects accuracy. If a user's birth time is uncertain, mention that rectification can be discussed.
- Do not attach urgency, fear or inevitability to any recommendation. This practice does not sell fear.
